description: This is a CMake script file containing functions and macros for build configuration, target dependency management, and package configuration support. It includes utility functions for managing target properties, generating configuration files, and installing package files within a project.

methods.name: add_element
methods.description: A macro to append an element to a list variable.

methods.name: _get_default_link_name
methods.description: Determines the default library name and location components from a given library path.

methods.name: get_if_link_libraries
methods.description: Retrieves the link libraries and directories associated with a target, including dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_defines
methods.description: Fetches all compile definitions (preprocessor macros) for a target, resolving interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_options
methods.description: Retrieves compile options for a target, including inherited options from dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_include_dirs
methods.description: Gathers all include directories associated with a target, resolving dependencies.

methods.name: InstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Installs a CMake package configuration file (.cmake) for a target, with support for dependencies and templates.

methods.name: InstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Creates and installs a pkg-config (.pc) file for a target, including compile options, defines, include dirs, and libraries.

methods.name: InstallFindModule
methods.description: Installs custom CMake find modules (.cmake files) from specified directories, optionally recursively.

methods.name: print_properties
methods.description: Prints the list of CMake properties available in CMake.

methods.name: print_target_properties
methods.description: Displays all the properties of a specified target.

methods.name: semicolon_safe_string
methods.description: Replaces semicolons in a string to make it safe for CMake variable passing.

methods.name: InstallCompatibleCMakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a compatible CMake configuration target for legacy or alternative build systems, linking to an existing target.
